prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the supplied nighttime home-office photograph.
Primary request: Keep this exact attractive home desk, warm orange lamp, dark window, monitor, walnut surface, room composition, clothing and wired CYMBA earphones, but make the man feel more ordinary and naturally relaxed. Change his posture, expression and overly idealised facial features as described below. Preserve the landscape 3:2 framing and photographic environment.

Posture: He is leaning back a little into the ergonomic chair, about 15–20 degrees more reclined than in the source, with his shoulders lower and visibly farther away from the desk. The backrest supports his upper back. He looks comfortably settled while reading the screen, not leaning forward or posing. One hand loosely rests on the mouse; the other can rest naturally on the chair armrest or his lap. Keep believable arm reach, elbows, wrists and fingers; do not stretch his arms or force both hands onto the keyboard while he reclines. His head remains upright enough to look at the monitor, with the visible ear and earbud unobscured.

Expression: Reduce the smile substantially to a barely perceptible hint of contentment. Lips nearly straight and relaxed, only a tiny lift at one corner, no teeth, no pronounced smirk, cheeks relaxed. Eyes directed at his work; calm and comfortable, not unhappy or dramatically tired.

Facial realism: Retain his general age in the thirties and dark hair/stubble, but give him less polished, everyday features. A softer and slightly asymmetrical jaw rather than the sharply chiselled model jaw, modest irregularity of nose and brows, ordinary under-eye shadows, slightly uneven skin tone, natural pores, a couple of tiny incidental blemishes, patchier stubble and a few stray hairs. Subtle human variation rather than exaggerated imperfections. This should look like an unretouched candid photo of a real ordinary person at home, not a handsome advertising model with a skin-texture filter.

Photographic treatment: Keep the original warm practical lamplight and small cool-neutral monitor fill, with believable uneven light and natural shadow on the face. Preserve the real material texture, modest photographic grain and depth of field. No skin smoothing, beauty retouching, exaggerated symmetry, HDR or illustration. Maintain good image detail without artificial sharpening.

Invariants: Keep the desk setup, lamp and its orange glow, room, nighttime window, monitor and overall crop consistent with the source. Keep the same earphone design, realistic size, correct in-ear fit, and a physically continuous black cable down the clothing. Preserve natural skin colour, anatomy and realistic shadows. No extra people, accessories, text, logos, watermark or fake film borders. Full opaque photographic background.
